title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 21: Naboth's vineyard, Jezebel's false letters, and Elijah's word of judgment against Ahab.

questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:1 says Naboth's vineyard was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

answers.text: In Samaria, by the city gate
In Jezreel, next to Ahab's palace

questions.text: What did Ahab want to use Naboth's vineyard for?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 21:2 Ahab asks for the vineyard so that he may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near his house.

answers.text: A place to build an altar

questions.text: Why did Naboth refuse to give Ahab his vineyard?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 21:3 Naboth says, "May Yahweh forbid me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you!"

answers.text: Ahab did not offer enough money
He planned to give it to his son
It was the inheritance of his fathers

questions.text: What did Ahab do after Naboth refused?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:4 says Ahab lay down on his bed, turned away his face, and would eat no bread.

answers.text: Lay on his bed and would not eat
Sent soldiers to seize the vineyard
Went to ask Elijah for advice

questions.text: In whose name did Jezebel write the letters to the elders and nobles?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:8 says she wrote letters in Ahab's name and sealed them with his seal.

questions.text: What were the two wicked fellows to accuse Naboth of?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 21:10 Jezebel writes that two wicked fellows should testify against Naboth, saying, "You cursed God and the king!"

answers.text: Killing a man in the field

questions.text: How was Naboth put to death?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:13 says they carried him out of the city and stoned him to death with stones.

answers.text: He was stoned outside the city
He was killed with the sword
He was thrown from the wall
He was hanged at the gate

questions.text: What did Ahab say when Elijah met him in Naboth's vineyard?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:20 says Ahab said to Elijah, "Have you found me, my enemy?"

questions.text: What did Yahweh say would happen in the place where dogs licked Naboth's blood?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 21:19 Yahweh says, "In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth, dogs will lick your blood, even yours."

answers.text: A new altar would be built

questions.text: Because Ahab humbled himself, when did Yahweh say he would bring the evil?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 21:29 Yahweh says that because Ahab humbles himself, he will not bring the evil in Ahab's days, but on his house in his son's day.

answers.text: On the day of his death
